cards.name: record_payment_view
cards.spec: record_payment_view(request, pk) records a payment for the sale with that pk. Read the posted field amount and convert it with Decimal. If the amount is invalid (not a number) show messages.error('Enter a valid amount.') and create nothing. Otherwise call record_payment(sale, amount), imported from sales.services. If it raises ValueError show the error text with messages.error. On success show 'Payment recorded.' Always redirect to sales:list. Only POST is allowed.
